observations.text: Cross washes closed bright paper lanes while leaving broad water bands.
Overlapping blue strokes kept the body filled; pale breast initially detached and thin.
Unequal crest tips broke the square head silhouette.
Loaded cream separated breast from water; blue belt stayed blunt.
Two feet met the perch without later grain crossings.
Folded wing planes separated, with strong inner shadow.
Small eye read in whole view; wing neighbors changed relief more than shadow color.
Rust band landed as a floating rectangular patch.
Joined ends and cream top narrowed rust patch to a shallow horseshoe.
Sparse unequal wing dashes retained broad open blue planes.
Tail accents stayed quiet; pale belt-end hooks remained.
Continuous reeds balanced perch; seed head showed slight attachment gap.
Connector joined seed head and low water veil subdued bright bottom strip.
Broken wood light avoided feet; throat transition softened but retained raised joins.
Four-pixel eye glint barely visible after settling.
Broader fully loaded touch gave a compact visible eye reflection.

Final paired review retained filled body, continuous collar, sparse pattern and compact eye light. Mouth/belt color contrast softened partly; faceted crown and regular bristles remain. Further covers would add relief faster than useful form.
